title: Automated system for establishing standard radiation dose-response curves and dose estimation for the Korean population.
summary: Full PMC article reports automated dicentric-chromosome scoring and a regression deep neural network for radiation-dose estimation, validated on blinded samples and worker monitoring. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
ai_technology: Automatic chromosome-image scoring plus regression DNN estimates dose from dose-response curves.
organization: Dongnam Institute of Radiological and Medical Sciences (DIRAMS), 40 Jwadong-gil, Jangan-eup, Gijang-gun, Busan, 46033, Republic of Korea

evidence.tested: The specific result is Korean-population biological dosimetry and dose estimation.
evidence.unknown: 30 donor curves, blinded samples, 95% confidence interval checks and five monitored workers provide validation.
evidence.ai_role: Automatic chromosome-image scoring plus regression DNN estimates dose from dose-response curves.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
